Main flow: user chat -> model streams partial text -> model triggers function_call to internal ticketing microservice (name: ticketer) with structured JSON arguments. Example from their logs includes raw stream chunks that, when concatenated, produce invalid JSON and double-escaped strings (raw sample omitted). They are also seeing tooling mismatches: their function schema expects arguments as JSON object, but streaming arrives as stringified JSON; SE suggested using function schema that lists argument types and to avoid double-stringifying. Also asked for sample serverless lambda showing how to buffer stream data and call JSON.parse on concatenated arguments safely. Security: SOC2 required for contract; they prefer Redwood hosted (public cloud) but will want a dedicated encryption key (KMS) later.
